rows.body: The constraint is no longer lack of features. It is the gap between customer intent, platform behaviour and business outcomes.

dynamicSlides.title: Despite digital investment, value realization remains uneven.
dynamicSlides.tagline: The symptoms are visible across acquisition, adoption, relationship growth and servicing.
dynamicSlides.rightText:
INTELLIGENT PLATFORMS
Show the same journey to everyone
Adapt to customer intent and context
Wait for customers to search
Anticipate the likely next need
Surface products through campaigns
Recommend useful actions at relevant moments
Treat each interaction independently
Carry context across journeys and channels
Escalate when self-service fails
Guide, resolve or route with context
AI matters when it changes the behaviour of the platform—not merely when it adds a chatbot.

rows.title: DIGITAL ACQUISITION
rows.body:
• High traffic, low conversion
• Product pages inform but do not guide
• Application and onboarding drop-offs remain high
• Assisted sales still needed for clarity

rows.title: DIGITAL ADOPTION
rows.body:
• Customers use only a small set of features
• Everyday tasks take too many steps
• Feature launches do not automatically create usage
• Engagement drops after basic transactions

rows.title: RELATIONSHIP GROWTH
rows.body:
• Product holding remains shallow
• Offers feel generic or poorly timed
• Cross-sell depends on campaigns / RMs
• Data is available, but not turned into next actions

rows.title: DIGITAL SERVICING
rows.body:
• Self-service stops before resolution
• Customers fall back to call centres, branches and RMs
• Context is lost across channels
• Cost to serve stays high

dynamicSlides.title: Our response: three simple BFSI offerings
dynamicSlides.tagline: Each offering is tied to a business outcome, not just a design or technology deliverable.

rows.title: DIGITAL SALES & ACQUISITION
rows.body:
• Increase qualified acquisition and application conversion.
• Pre-login website, product discovery, calculators, onboarding, assisted journeys.

rows.title: DIGITAL ENGAGEMENT & RELATIONSHIP GROWTH
rows.body:
• Increase adoption, product usage, cross-sell and share of wallet among ETB customers.
• Mobile banking, internet banking, financial management, feature adoption, next-best actions.

rows.title: INTELLIGENT SERVICING
rows.body:
• Reduce servicing cost while improving resolution and customer experience.
• Service Intelligence Stack, self-service, routing, RM and employee tools, automation.
